justification: Both surfaces present a long horizontal row of repeated upright human figures aligned along a baseline, which is the only real correspondence, and it is a very generic one. A shows a boat hull with abstract stroke-like crew marks and no detail whatsoever, while B shows individually modelled bearded figures in robes with headgear, hands touching and held objects, framed by rosette bands — different subject matter and utterly different depictive conventions.
